reference.source: Independent actual public Source queued-position owner counterpart for the Source closed positional-ref DOM/model bug. The original public actions and props are unchanged; only public owner ref scheduling differs. No Native geometry, Source patches, callback filters or result corrections.
reference.protocol: Stable token.motion=false, explicit public popupOverflow=viewport, all public event callbacks recorded verbatim through a mutable owner ledger. Three identical complete public projections separated by two real frames/two tasks. Closed popup DOM remains in raw; unavailable virtual row keys/indices are not inferred from React internals.

counterpart.policy: The public owner queues positional ref requests while closed without calling the Source ref, then invokes that original public ref.scrollTo once after a public animation frame observes the reopened public holder has positive clientHeight. Props, data and all original actions remain unchanged. All DOM, coordinates and callbacks are actual unmodified Source observations.
